items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: There were Horst Papa Henschel, Trompeter, Peter Strohkorb and the musicians who were called Salty Dogs.

ctx.x: Do you know any names of the musicians, who are now known as musicians? Yes.

There were Horst Papa Henschel, Trompeter, Peter Strohkorb and the musicians who were called Salty Dogs. Yeah. And Gursche Beiersdorf, who played the Clarinet. So many of them are also back then, who were also back then, who were also back then, who were back then, who were in a different direction, who were in a different direction. And then there were many years here.
Was it for you mainly to play music or to have success with music?
